doc.name: Raziel Calculators
doc.instructions: Raziel Calculators: free investment and startup finance tools from Raziel (raziel.co). Use the calculators for exact math instead of estimating: IRR and XIRR, MOIC, CAGR, fund TVPI/DPI, carried interest, SAFE and convertible note conversion, valuation, dilution, option pool, pro rata, liquidation preferences, secondary sales, QSBS (Section 1202), 83(b) and QSBS dates, runway, cap rate, cash on cash and portfolio allocation. Founder metrics: burn multiple, Rule of 40, LTV to CAC, CAC payback and net revenue retention. Reference: search_guides searches Raziel guides to cite, define_term defines private-market terms, compare_platforms compares Raziel with other platforms. Prompts: investor_update, due_diligence_checklist and data_room_checklist. Inputs: money in USD (*_usd), percentages as percent numbers (20 = 20%, *_pct), dates as YYYY-MM-DD. Each result includes calculator_url, a page the user can open to adjust the inputs. Results are for education only, not tax, legal or investment advice.

tools.name: irr
tools.title: IRR calculator
tools.description: Internal rate of return for evenly spaced yearly cash flows after an initial investment. Use xirr instead when cash flows have specific dates or irregular timing. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/irr-calculator

initial_investment_usd.description: Amount invested at the start (year 0), as a positive number.

cash_flows_usd.description: Net cash flow for each following year, in order (year 1, year 2, ...). Positive = money received, negative = more money invested.

items.description: Net cash flow for the year in USD.

tools.name: xirr
tools.title: XIRR calculator
tools.description: Annualized return (XIRR) for cash flows on specific dates, like Excel XIRR. Use this for real investments with irregular timing (capital calls, distributions, follow-ons); use irr only for evenly spaced yearly flows. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/xirr-calculator

cash_flows.description: Dated cash flows in any order. Negative amount = money invested, positive = money received or current value.

date.description: Date of the cash flow, YYYY-MM-DD.

amount_usd.description: Amount in USD. Negative = invested, positive = received.

tools.name: moic
tools.title: MOIC calculator
tools.description: Multiple on invested capital: total value returned (distributions plus current value) divided by the amount invested, with the implied annualized return when a holding period is given. Use tvpi_dpi for fund-level LP multiples. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/moic-calculator

invested_usd.description: Total capital invested, including follow-on checks.

value_returned_usd.description: Cash received from exits and distributions plus the current value of anything still held.

years.description: Holding period in years, used for the annualized return. 0 if unknown.

tools.name: cagr
tools.title: CAGR calculator
tools.description: Compound annual growth rate between a start value and an end value over a number of years. Use for growth of a single value (revenue, an asset price); use irr or xirr when there are multiple cash flows. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/cagr-calculator

years.description: Number of years between the two values.

tools.name: tvpi_dpi
tools.title: TVPI and DPI calculator
tools.description: Fund performance multiples for an LP or a fund: TVPI (total value to paid-in), DPI (distributions to paid-in, realized) and RVPI (NAV to paid-in, unrealized). Use moic for a single deal and xirr for time-weighted returns. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/tvpi-dpi-calculator

paid_in_usd.description: Capital called and contributed to date, including fees.

distributions_usd.description: Cumulative cash and stock distributed to date.

nav_usd.description: Latest reported residual value (net asset value).

commitment_usd.description: Total commitment, used only for the called percentage. 0 if unknown.

tools.name: carried_interest
tools.title: Carried interest calculator
tools.description: European (whole-fund) distribution waterfall: management fees, return of capital, preferred return (hurdle), GP catch-up and carried interest split, with LP net multiple and the gross-to-net drag. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/carried-interest-calculator

management_fee_pct.description: Annual management fee on commitments, percent.

fee_years.description: Years the full fee is charged.

step_down_fee_pct.description: Annual fee after the step-down, percent. 0 for none.

step_down_years.description: Years the step-down fee is charged.

mode.description: "moic" to give a gross multiple on invested capital, "proceeds" to give total exit proceeds.

hurdle_pct.description: Preferred return per year, percent. 0 for no hurdle.

years.description: Years from capital call to distribution.

tools.name: safe_conversion
tools.title: SAFE conversion calculator
tools.description: How a YC-style SAFE (post-money or pre-money) converts in a priced equity round: conversion price, whether the cap or discount applies, shares issued and ownership after the round, including an option pool top-up. Use convertible_note for notes that accrue interest. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/safe-conversion-calculator

safe_type.description: SAFE type: "post" for post-money SAFEs (the YC standard since 2018), "pre" for older pre-money SAFEs.

discount_pct.description: Discount to the round price in percent (20 = 20%). 0 means no discount.

existing_shares.description: Fully diluted shares before the priced round, including the unissued option pool.

existing_pool_shares.description: Unissued option pool shares today (part of existing_shares).

priced_round_pre_money_usd.description: Pre-money valuation of the priced round.

priced_round_raise_usd.description: New money raised in the priced round, not counting the SAFE.

target_pool_pct.description: Target unissued option pool after the round, as a percent of post-money fully diluted shares. 0 for no top-up.

tools.name: convertible_note
tools.title: Convertible note calculator
tools.description: How a convertible note converts in a priced round: accrued interest, conversion price (cap vs discount), shares received and effective discount. Use safe_conversion for SAFEs, which have no interest. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/convertible-note-calculator

interest_mode.description: How interest accrues: simple, compounded annually, or compounded monthly.

discount_pct.description: Discount to the round price in percent. 0 means no discount.

priced_round_pre_money_usd.description: Pre-money valuation of the priced round.

round_price_per_share_usd.description: Price per share paid by new investors in the round.

tools.name: startup_valuation
tools.title: Startup valuation calculator
tools.description: Pre-money to post-money for a single priced round: post-money valuation, price per share, new shares issued, investor ownership (investment / post-money) and founder dilution. Use dilution for several rounds and option_pool for pool math. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/startup-valuation-calculator

shares_before.description: Fully diluted shares before the round.

option_pool_pct.description: Option pool after the round, percent (taken from the founders’ share).

tools.name: dilution
tools.title: Startup dilution calculator
tools.description: Founder and investor ownership across several future funding rounds, including option pool top-ups before each round. Use option_pool for a single round when the question is how a pre-money pool shifts value, and startup_valuation for one simple round. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/dilution-calculator

founders_pct.description: Founders’ combined ownership today, percent of fully diluted shares.

option_pool_pct.description: Unissued option pool today, percent of fully diluted shares. Anything not founders or pool is treated as existing investors.

raise_usd.description: New money raised in the round.

target_pool_pct.description: Target unissued pool after the round, percent of post-money. 0 for no top-up.

tools.name: option_pool
tools.title: Option pool calculator
tools.description: The "option pool shuffle" for one round: how much the pool must grow to hit a post-money target, the effective pre-money valuation, and how much founder ownership the pre-money pool costs versus adding it after the round. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/option-pool-calculator

raise_usd.description: New money raised in the round.

target_pool_pct.description: Target unissued pool after the round, percent of post-money.

existing_pool_pct.description: Unissued pool today, percent of pre-round fully diluted shares.

founders_pct.description: Founders today, percent of pre-round fully diluted shares.

fully_diluted_shares.description: Fully diluted shares today. Optional; enables per-share outputs.

tools.name: pro_rata
tools.title: Pro rata calculator
tools.description: For an existing investor in a new round: the check needed to keep the same ownership (pro rata), ownership after the round if they skip or write a planned check, and the value of the stake at the new post-money. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/pro-rata-calculator

current_ownership_pct.description: Your current fully diluted ownership in percent.

round_raise_usd.description: Total new money raised in the round, including pro rata checks.

planned_check_usd.description: The check you plan to write. 0 to only see the pro rata amount.

tools.name: liquidation_preference
tools.title: Liquidation preference calculator
tools.description: Exit waterfall: how sale proceeds split between preferred series and common, with preference multiples, non-participating, participating or capped participation, and stacked or pari passu seniority. Each series converts to common when that pays more. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/liquidation-preference-calculator

exit_value_usd.description: Net proceeds to equity holders at the exit.

common_shares.description: Common shares outstanding, including exercised options (fully diluted common).

seniority.description: "stacked": later series are paid first (listed last = most senior). "pari": all series share preferences pro rata.

participation.description: Non-participating, fully participating, or participating up to a cap.

participation_cap_multiple.description: Capped participation only: total payout cap as a multiple of the amount invested (3 = 3x).

tools.name: secondary_sale
tools.title: Secondary sale calculator
tools.description: Proceeds from selling private company shares on the secondary market: sale price after a discount (or premium) to the last round price or a valuation, fees, net proceeds, gain over cost basis and the implied company valuation. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/secondary-sale-calculator

price_basis.description: "price": reference is the last preferred price per share. "valuation": reference is a company valuation divided by fully diluted shares.

reference_price_per_share_usd.description: Last preferred price per share (price basis).

fully_diluted_shares.description: Company fully diluted shares. Required for the valuation basis; optional otherwise.

discount_pct.description: Discount to the reference price, percent. Negative for a premium.

cost_basis_usd.description: Total cost basis of the shares sold.

fees_pct.description: Broker or platform fees, percent of gross proceeds.

tools.name: qsbs
tools.title: QSBS (Section 1202) calculator
tools.description: Estimates the US federal capital gains exclusion for qualified small business stock under IRC Section 1202, including the July 2025 changes (tiered 3, 4 and 5 year exclusions and the $15M cap for stock acquired after July 4, 2025). Assumes the stock otherwise qualifies. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/qsbs-calculator

sold_date.description: Date the stock is or will be sold (YYYY-MM-DD).

basis_usd.description: Adjusted basis of the shares sold.

prior_gain_usd.description: Gain from the same company already excluded in earlier years.

tools.name: tax_deadlines
tools.title: 83(b) and QSBS date calculator
tools.description: Key US equity tax dates. stock_grant_date: the 83(b) election deadline, 30 days after restricted stock is transferred (rolled to the next business day when the 30th day is a weekend or legal holiday). qsbs_acquired_date: the Section 1202 holding-period milestones (50%, 75% and 100% exclusion at 3, 4 and 5 years for stock acquired after July 4, 2025; 5 years before). Give either or both. Use qsbs for the dollar exclusion on a sale. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/qsbs-calculator

stock_grant_date.description: Date the restricted stock was transferred or granted (YYYY-MM-DD), for the 83(b) deadline.

qsbs_acquired_date.description: Date the stock was acquired (YYYY-MM-DD), for QSBS holding-period dates.

as_of_date.description: Count days from this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today (UTC).

tools.name: runway
tools.title: Startup runway calculator
tools.description: Months of cash runway for a startup, either from a monthly net burn ("burn" mode) or from monthly revenue and expenses with growth rates ("pl" mode), including the break-even month and whether the company is default alive within 10 years. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/runway-calculator

mode.description: "burn": give monthly net burn. "pl": give monthly revenue and expenses.

monthly_burn_usd.description: Burn mode: monthly net burn (cash out minus cash in).

burn_growth_pct.description: Burn mode: month-over-month change in burn, percent (2 = +2% a month).

revenue_growth_pct.description: P&L mode: month-over-month revenue growth, percent.

expense_growth_pct.description: P&L mode: month-over-month expense growth, percent.

tools.name: cap_rate
tools.title: Cap rate calculator
tools.description: Capitalization rate of an income property (net operating income / property value), plus gross rent multiplier and price per unit. Give noi_usd directly or gross income and operating expenses. Use cash_on_cash when financing matters. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/cap-rate-calculator

property_value_usd.description: Purchase price or current market value.

noi_usd.description: Annual net operating income. If omitted, gross income minus operating expenses is used.

operating_expenses_usd.description: Annual operating expenses, excluding mortgage payments.

units.description: Number of units, for price per unit. 0 to skip.

tools.name: cash_on_cash
tools.title: Cash on cash return calculator
tools.description: Leveraged rental property returns: mortgage payment, NOI, annual cash flow, cash on cash return, DSCR and break-even occupancy. Use cap_rate for an unlevered view of the same property. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/cash-on-cash-return-calculator

down_payment_pct.description: Down payment as a percent of price.

closing_costs_usd.description: Closing costs and upfront repairs paid in cash.

monthly_rent_usd.description: Gross monthly rent across all units.

vacancy_pct.description: Vacancy and credit loss, percent of gross rent.

operating_expenses_usd.description: Annual operating expenses: taxes, insurance, repairs, management, HOA.

interest_rate_pct.description: Mortgage interest rate, percent per year.

tools.name: portfolio_allocation
tools.title: Portfolio allocation analyzer
tools.description: Allocation of a portfolio across asset classes (stocks, bonds, real estate, crypto, venture capital, private equity, cash, other), with a simple diversification score and a concentration read. Holdings in the same class are summed. Interactive version: https://raziel.co/tools/portfolio-allocation

holdings.description: Each holding with its asset class and current value.

tools.name: burn_multiple
tools.title: Burn multiple
tools.description: Capital efficiency: net burn divided by net new ARR over the same period (a quarter or a year). Lower is better. Returns the multiple and a rough band (under 1 amazing, 1 to 1.5 great, 1.5 to 2 good, 2 to 3 suspect, over 3 bad, a rule of thumb popularized by David Sacks). Use rule_of_40 for growth versus profitability instead. Guide: https://raziel.co/learn/importance-startup-burn-rate

net_burn_usd.description: Net cash burned in the period (cash out minus cash in), as a positive number.

net_new_arr_usd.description: Net new annual recurring revenue added in the same period (new + expansion - churn). Can be negative.

tools.name: rule_of_40
tools.title: Rule of 40
tools.description: Adds revenue growth rate and profit margin (usually EBITDA or free cash flow margin, both in percent). A score of 40 or more is the common rule of thumb for a healthy software company balancing growth and profitability. Use burn_multiple for capital efficiency instead. Guide: https://raziel.co/learn/evaluating-startup-traction-metrics

revenue_growth_pct.description: Year-over-year revenue growth in percent (60 = 60%). Can be negative.

profit_margin_pct.description: Profit margin in percent, EBITDA or free cash flow margin (-15 = -15%).

tools.name: ltv_cac
tools.title: LTV to CAC
tools.description: Customer lifetime value (monthly revenue per account x gross margin / monthly churn) compared with customer acquisition cost. Returns LTV, the LTV:CAC ratio and CAC payback months. Around 3:1 or better is a commonly cited target. Use cac_payback when you only need the payback period. Guide: https://raziel.co/learn/unit-economics-early-stage-startups

arpa_monthly_usd.description: Average revenue per account per month.

monthly_churn_pct.description: Monthly customer churn in percent (2 = 2%). Must be above 0.

cac_usd.description: Fully loaded cost to acquire one customer (sales and marketing spend / new customers).

tools.name: cac_payback
tools.title: CAC payback period
tools.description: Months of gross profit needed to earn back the cost of acquiring a customer: CAC / (monthly revenue per account x gross margin). Give cac_usd directly, or sales_marketing_spend_usd and new_customers for the same period. Many SaaS investors look for roughly 12 to 18 months or less, shorter for SMB. Use ltv_cac to also see lifetime value. Guide: https://raziel.co/learn/unit-economics-early-stage-startups

cac_usd.description: Cost to acquire one customer. Optional if spend and new customers are given.

sales_marketing_spend_usd.description: Sales and marketing spend in the period (used with new_customers when cac_usd is not given).

new_customers.description: New customers won in the same period.

arpa_monthly_usd.description: Average revenue per account per month.

tools.name: net_revenue_retention
tools.title: Net and gross revenue retention
tools.description: Net revenue retention (NRR) and gross revenue retention (GRR) for a cohort of existing customers over a period, usually 12 months: (starting revenue + expansion - contraction - churn) / starting revenue. Above 100% NRR means existing customers grow on their own. Exclude revenue from new customers. Guide: https://raziel.co/learn/evaluating-startup-traction-metrics

starting_mrr_usd.description: Recurring revenue from the cohort at the start of the period (MRR or ARR, use the same basis throughout).

expansion_usd.description: Upsell and expansion revenue from that cohort.

churned_usd.description: Revenue lost from customers in that cohort who left.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.title: Search Raziel guides
tools.description: Searches Raziel's 370 Learn articles on private investing, startups, funds and founder topics (SAFEs, cap tables, K-1s, capital calls, QSBS, investor updates and more). Returns titles, URLs, summaries and matching section headings to cite. Use define_term for a one-line definition instead.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words, e.g. "safe discount vs valuation cap".

tools.name: define_term
tools.title: Define a private-market term
tools.description: Plain-English definition of a private-market, venture or fund term (pro rata, MFN, liquidation preference, valuation cap, DPI, TVPI, carried interest, hurdle, capital call, NAV, K-1, QSBS, 83(b), 409A, drag-along, ROFR and about 33 more), with a link to the Raziel guide or calculator. Pass "list" to get every term. Use search_guides for longer explanations.

term.description: The term or abbreviation, e.g. "pro rata" or "DPI". Use "list" for all terms.

tools.name: compare_platforms
tools.title: Compare Raziel with another platform
tools.description: Researched, sourced comparison of Raziel with another investing or startup platform (Addepar, Allocations, AngelList, Cake Equity, Carta, Empower, Eqvista, Foundersuite, getquin, Juniper Square, Kubera, Ledgy, Masttro, Pulley, Seraf, Sharesight, spreadsheets, Sydecar, Visible, Vyzer): pricing, feature coverage, key differences, where the other platform is stronger, and sources. Pass "list" to see every platform. Facts are as of the research date in the result.

competitor.description: Platform name, e.g. "Carta" or "AngelList". Use "list" for all.

prompts.name: investor_update
prompts.title: Draft a monthly investor update
prompts.description: For founders: drafts a concise monthly investor update in the structure Raziel recommends (summary, metrics, wins, challenges, financials, team, asks).

arguments.name: metrics
arguments.description: Key numbers this period (revenue, growth, burn, runway, customers)

arguments.name: lowlights
arguments.description: Challenges, misses and what you are doing about them

arguments.name: asks
arguments.description: Specific help you want from investors

prompts.name: due_diligence_checklist
prompts.title: Startup due diligence checklist
prompts.description: For investors: builds a due diligence checklist for a specific startup and stage, with the questions to ask and documents to request.

arguments.name: stage
arguments.description: Round or stage, e.g. "pre-seed SAFE" or "Series A"

prompts.name: data_room_checklist
prompts.title: Fundraising data room checklist
prompts.description: For founders: lists what to put in a fundraising data room for your stage, split into a first-look folder and full diligence folders.
